snippet.title: Octillery VS. Collection - Playthrough (Part 1)
snippet.description:
The Octillery Vs. Collection was made by Vidyabatter, download/play it on a website of your choosing:
https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/875310
https://joeythemarillfan.itch.io/octilleryvscollection
https://gamejolt.com/games/octillerycollection224/792479

Finally, I return to doing Playthroughs, this'll be a multi-part Playthrough, probably around like 3 or 4 Parts or something. In this Part we tackle the first Game in the Collection: "Octillery VS. Xi Jinping."
